rubric.role_summary: Customer Success Manager for a biotech R&D software platform, focused on customer adoption, deployment health, value realization, and data-informed customer strategies.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Customer Success Manager for a biotech R&D software platform, focused on customer adoption, deployment health, value realization, and data-informed customer strategies.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- BS or M.Sc in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, or a similar Life Science field; OR 2+ years of work experience with Life Sciences or Healthcare companies.
- 4+ years of Customer Success, Professional Services, or Consulting experience in a SaaS software environment.
- Project management skills.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Life Sciences or Healthcare work experience in a lab or research setting.
- Hands-on implementation experience.
- Experience working with or supporting the Benchling platform.
- Understanding of Life Sciences R&D, process development, or manufacturing processes and scientific concepts.
- Experience interfacing with practitioners and Director- or VP-level Business and IT leaders at Biotech and Pharma companies.
- Proficiency with CS tools such as Gainsight, Salesforce, and analytics/BI tools; comfort using AI tools for productivity and customer insights.
- GxP experience or familiarity with validation activities at a life sciences, biotech, or vertical SaaS company.
- Experience leveraging data insights to drive decisions, diagnose customer deployment health, and develop targeted adoption strategies.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Boston area, Massachusetts. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
